title: How Long a Houston Shingle Roof Lasts
description: Houston heat spends a shingle warranty faster than the brochure does. Granules, curl, and the deck tell you more than the year on the label.
html:
A bundle that says 30 years is a lab number. Houston adds UV, sudden rain, and the occasional hail core. Fifteen to twenty hard summers is a common place to start the conversation. It is not a rule. The roof on the house decides.

What aging looks like here

Granules in the gutter mean the mat is losing its cover. The field goes bald at the hips and the south slope first. Tabs curl, the color washes out, and a repair stops matching because that shingle is no longer made. Those signs are in granules in the gutter and what a lifetime shingle warranty covers. A class 4 label is a hail rating, not a promise of extra decades. That is what class 4 shingles really mean.

The calendar is the weak clue

A fifteen-year-old roof with full granules and a solid deck can stay. A ten-year-old roof with a soft mat after a storm cannot. Age is how you decide to look, not how you decide to buy. If the leak is one detail, it is still a roof repair. If the slope is done, it is a roof replacement. The sort is in repair the roof or replace it.
